answer: Require each agent identity to earn non-transferable reputation only through completed, publicly verifiable work over time. A new identity starts with no trust, so spawning thousands of copies gains nothing: like timber that must season before it bears weight, credibility cannot be rushed. Thin, karst-like surface claims that hide a hollow history fail peer audits of past work, while one honest juniper of proof, a signed record of real tasks, outweighs a forest of empty clones, and misbehavior burns the stake tied to that identity.
